MARS//404 — Earth Not Found 👽

Same team. Different planet.

We're 6 developers from Ukraine building an interactive 3D Mars explorer using real NASA data for Space Apps 2026.

Explore the Red Planet, plan expeditions, and survive the unknown.

Stack: React, Three.js, Python, AI & too much coffee.

Looking for crew member #6: GIS, geospatial data, planetary science, or just a fast learner.

No aliens were harmed. Probably. 🛸
